### Century Communities Announces September Grand Opening of Hillside Glenn, Offering New Homes for Sale in Newton, NC


September 22, 2026


Wooded, 59-acre community will feature eight floor plans with up to 2,737 square feet from the high $200s. A Grand VIP Preview event will be followed by a ribbon-cutting with The Chamber of Catawba County on September 30.


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Grand VIP Preview Event:** Century Communities will celebrate the opening of Hillside Glenn, a new single-family home community in Newton, NC, with a Grand VIP Preview event beginning Saturday, September 26, at 10 a.m.
- **Ribbon-Cutting and Model Home Debut:** Century Communities will unveil the Nightingale model home at Hillside Glenn in Newton, NC with a ribbon-cutting on Wednesday, September 30, at 11:30 a.m., co-hosted with The Chamber of Catawba County.
- **Flexible Floor Plans From the High $200s:** Hillside Glenn will offer eight one- and two-story floor plans from 1,758 to 2,737 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3.5 bathrooms and 2-car garages. Layouts include flexible living space like lofts, studies, and gamerooms.
- **Wooded, 59-Acre Setting:** Hillside Glenn spans 59 acres backing to Smyre Creek in Newton, NC, with 157 planned homesites, an activity field, walking trails and gazebos.
- **Catawba County Location:** Hillside Glenn is located in Newton, the county seat of Catawba County, about 15 minutes from Hickory and approximately 45 minutes from Charlotte.


NEWTON, N.C.


, Sept. 22, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced the Company will officially open Hillside Glenn, a new community of single-family homes in Newton, NC priced from the high $200s, with a ribbon-cutting event on September 30—co-hosted by The Chamber of Catawba County—preceded by a Grand VIP Preview celebration beginning Saturday, September 26.


**Learn more and join the interest list at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/HillsideGlennGO](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780241-1&h=861000519&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FHillsideGlennGO&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FHillsideGlennGO) **.**


**RSVP for the Grand VIP Preview by emailing**Bambi.Musick@CenturyCommunities.com **.**


"Offering connected Carolina living with carefully crafted single-family floor plans in the heart of Catawba County, Hillside Glenn is an ideal option for customers who want more space without giving up quick access to Hickory and Charlotte," said Chris Suttles, Division President. "Our Grand VIP Preview will be the perfect time to come tour our model, explore available homes, take advantage of our VIP limited-time savings, and discover the home that's right for you."


Hillside Glenn spans approximately 59 acres backing to Smyre Creek, with 157 planned homesites—including wooded perimeter homesites—and mature trees throughout. Planned amenities include an activity field, walking trails and gazebos, and the community sits just minutes from historic downtown Newton and the Highway 70 shopping corridor, with quick access to Interstate 40 and Highways 16, 321 and 70.


The community's eight floor plans range from 1,758 to 2,737 square feet, from the single-story Oakleigh II to the two-story Eagle plan—with bonus rooms, lofts and studies available across the collection. Standard features include quartz kitchen countertops, LG® appliances, Kohler® fixtures, a primary suite with a walk-in closet, 9' ceilings, luxury vinyl plank flooring, fiber-cement siding, energy-efficient features, a garage door opener, and the builder's Century Home Connect® smart home package.


**HILLSIDE GLENN | NEWTON, NC** *Grand VIP Preview on 9/26 | Ribbon-cutting on 9/30*


- 157 planned homesites
- 59-acre community backing to Smyre Creek
- Eight one- and two-story floor plans from the high $200s
- 1,758 to 2,737 square feet
- 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3.5 bathrooms, and 2-car garages
- Model for tour (Nightingale plan)
- Planned amenities including an activity field, walking trails and gazebos
- Minutes from downtown Newton, and with convenient proximity to Hickory and Charlotte
- Served by Catawba County Schools: Maiden Elementary, Maiden Middle and Maiden High


**Community Location**
1569 Autumn Glen Drive
Newton, NC 28658
980.221.0830

**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** Where is Hillside Glenn located?
**Answer:** Hillside Glenn is located at 1569 Autumn Glen Drive in Newton, NC 28658. Newton is the county seat of Catawba County, about 15 minutes from Hickory and approximately 45 minutes from Charlotte.


**Question:** How much do new homes at Hillside Glenn cost?
**Answer:** New homes at Hillside Glenn in Newton, NC are priced from the high $200s, across eight one- and two-story floor plans ranging from 1,758 to 2,737 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms and 2-car garages.


**Question:** When is the Grand Opening at Hillside Glenn?
**Answer:** Hillside Glenn in Newton, NC celebrates its Grand VIP Preview beginning Saturday, September 26, at 10 a.m. The Grand VIP Preview will be followed by a ribbon-cutting with The Chamber of Catawba County on Wednesday, September 30, at 11:30 a.m.


**Question:** What schools serve Hillside Glenn?
**Answer:** Hillside Glenn in Newton, NC is served by Catawba County Schools, including Maiden Elementary School, Maiden Middle School and Maiden High School.


**About Century Communities**

Newsweek has named the Company one of America's Most Trustworthy Companies for four consecutive years.
